records.our_prose: For sunflower shoots, the tray is the whole setup. Use a shallow tray with drainage holes sitting inside a solid tray so you can water from the bottom, plus a second tray on top with a weight for the dark phase. Wash and sanitize trays between batches.

records.source_context: Grow Your Own Microgreens What You Will Need Seeds Choose seeds labeled for microgreens, such as radish, broccoli, sunflower, or pea shoots. Growing Trays A shallow tray with drainage holes works best. You can also use repurposed containers, such as pie tins or takeout trays; 1020 trays work great for growing microgreens.
